metadata.title: त्रिपुरा: खुमलुंग से जंतर-मंतर दिल्ली तक आदिवासी आवाज़ | Celebration in Tripura, protest in Delhi
metadata.description: On August 23, 1984, a significant event took place in India involving the Sixth Schedule of the Indian Constitution. This amendment led to the holding of elections for the Tripura Tribal Areas Autonomous District Council (TTADC) in accordance with the provisions outlined in the Sixth Schedule. This change was a culmination of long-standing demands by tribal communities. Each year on this date, August 23, the tribal population in Tripura commemorates this event as the Sixth Scheduled Day. As is the tradition, celebrations are taking place today to mark this occasion.
